International enquiries

We welcome conversations with overseas producers, brands, exporters and buyers interested in working with an Indian premium food distributor.

Overseas suppliers & brands

If you produce or export seafood, Japanese or Asian specialty foods, cheese or other premium products and are looking for distribution in India, share your company profile, product list and certifications with us.

International buyers

Divya Luxury Foods Pvt. Ltd. holds an FSSAI Central Licence that includes importer and exporter business categories, and an Import Export Code (IEC) from DGFT. Our supply operations today primarily serve customers in India, so each cross-border request is reviewed individually — product availability, documentation and the regulations of both countries — before any commitment is made.
